scope.summary: Production capture/download ingest streams with incremental hash and backpressure, atomic idempotent finalization, abort/orphan cleanup, range reads, and bounded materialization without buffering large media/PDF/WARC payloads in memory.
acceptance_criteria: A large media/PDF/WARC stress run proves shared ingest streams once with incremental hash/backpressure, bounded memory, atomic idempotent finalize, abort/orphan recovery, range reads, and bounded handle materialization.
[positive] Stream payloads larger than the memory ceiling in bounded chunks, compute one digest, finalize to canonical handles, range-read exact bytes, and materialize via structured target.
[negative] Reject whole-buffer writes, reread solely for rehash, caller-path identity, wrong hash/stat finalize, per-chunk ledger writes, or staging visibility as final.
[failure_recovery] At every phase, cancel/disk-full/death/lost-ack faults abort or reconcile idempotently; verified orphans clean and completed handles are never duplicated/deleted.
[concurrency] Concurrent streams remain inside global/per-job byte/worker limits, preserve interactive reserve, backpressure fairly, and coalesce progress.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
Legacy Stage code (WP-12) must not silently constrain this MT (STAGE-DEC-017).
Do not duplicate ArtifactStore, WP-1 ToolGate/process/promotion, or Loom authority.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

planning_metadata.implementation_note: Planning-stage MT. Exact owned_files, code anchors, and proof_commands are bound at the L00 integration baseline. Deep spec detail lives in corpus_refs; acceptance_criteria carry the provable closure unit and the positive/negative/failure_recovery/concurrency case groups.
